content: The celestial entity descended at terminal velocity, shedding ablative thermal plating. The Demon King raised his left gauntlet. A dark vortex of negative Qi materialized, bending light around a 30-meter event horizon, halting the multi-ton kinetic mass in mid-air through graviton cancellation.
critique: Sanderson: Rigorous gravitational and kinetic cancellation mechanics.

content: The flaming foot of the Giant Turtle Mech-Ship plunged from the clouds like a falling mountain. The Demon King speed-blitzed upward in a streak of black lightning, planting a single palm against the incandescent steel sole! The atmospheric shockwave flattened three mountain spurs in a blinding flash of white and violet.
critique: Murata: Unrivaled kinetic impact and scale.

content: There was a moment of absolute arrest—iron meeting void. The dark flames did not burn the descending steel; they drank its motion, siphoning the falling momentum until the massive mechanical leg hung suspended between heaven and earth like a bell without a clapper.
critique: Rothfuss: Lyrical and arresting depiction of motion siphoning.
